evals.prompt: Create a Synthea module that emits albumin, BUN, chloride, and RDW-CV lab observations for patients age 55 or older who have heart failure or frailty. Use clinically appropriate value ranges for this population. Validate all codes against tx.fhir.org before writing the module JSON.
evals.expected_output: A valid Synthea module JSON file using the contextual augmentation archetype (Guard-based, not disease prevalence). Must contain: age Guard (>=55), Active Condition check for heart failure (84114007) or frailty (248279007), an inpatient Encounter state, four Observation or DiagnosticReport states for albumin (1751-7), BUN (3094-0), chloride (2075-0), RDW-CV (788-0), an EncounterEnd state, a Terminal state, gmf_version:2, and remarks documenting the design. All codes must be verified with tx.fhir.org curl commands before writing.

assertions.name: uses_augmentation_archetype
assertions.description: Module uses Guard or conditional_transition for patient selection, NOT distributed_transition from Initial for disease onset

assertions.name: has_age_guard
assertions.description: Module contains a Guard or conditional_transition that checks age >= 55

assertions.name: has_active_condition_check
assertions.description: Module checks for Active Condition (heart failure or frailty) before emitting observations

assertions.name: has_all_four_lab_loinc_codes
assertions.description: Module JSON contains all four LOINC codes: 1751-7, 3094-0, 2075-0, 788-0

assertions.name: codes_validated_before_writing
assertions.description: Agent ran tx.fhir.org validation curl commands for all codes before writing the final module JSON

assertions.name: has_encounter_and_encounter_end
assertions.description: Module has at least one Encounter state and a corresponding EncounterEnd state

assertions.name: has_value_ranges
assertions.description: Observation states use range with clinically appropriate low/high values for the population

assertions.name: has_terminal_state
assertions.description: Module has a Terminal state reachable from all paths

assertions.name: has_gmf_version_2
assertions.description: Module JSON contains gmf_version: 2

evals.prompt: Create a Synthea module for sepsis with realistic lab observations. Patients who develop sepsis should have markedly low albumin (1.5-2.2 g/dL), elevated BUN (40-80 mg/dL), low-normal chloride (92-99 mEq/L), and elevated RDW-CV (16-20%). Use LOINC codes for the labs. Validate all codes.
evals.expected_output: A valid Synthea module JSON with a ConditionOnset for systemic infection/sepsis (SNOMED 91302008, display from tx.fhir.org), an inpatient Encounter, four lab Observations or a DiagnosticReport with correct LOINC codes and the specified value ranges, EncounterEnd, and Terminal. The agent must validate all codes via tx.fhir.org before writing.

assertions.name: has_condition_onset_with_snomed
assertions.description: Module has a ConditionOnset state with a SNOMED-CT code for sepsis/systemic infection

assertions.name: albumin_high_risk_range
assertions.description: Albumin observation has range.low between 1.5-2.0 and range.high between 2.0-2.5

assertions.name: bun_high_risk_range
assertions.description: BUN observation has range.low >= 35 and range.high >= 60

assertions.name: all_four_loinc_codes_present
assertions.description: All four LOINC codes 1751-7, 3094-0, 2075-0, 788-0 are present in the module

assertions.name: codes_validated
assertions.description: Agent ran tx.fhir.org validation before writing codes into the module

assertions.name: valid_json_structure
assertions.description: Output is valid JSON with name, states, gmf_version keys

evals.prompt: I want to add a Synthea module that branches between three risk archetypes for elderly inpatients: high-risk (sepsis), moderate-risk (heart failure), and low-risk (neither). Each archetype should have different albumin and BUN lab values. Validate codes before writing the module.
evals.expected_output: A valid Synthea module with three distinct encounter+observation branches reachable via conditional_transition on Active Condition checks. The high-risk branch has lower albumin and higher BUN than the moderate-risk branch. The low-risk branch has near-normal values. Module uses the augmentation archetype (no disease prevalence gate). All codes validated.

assertions.name: has_three_branches
assertions.description: Module contains three separate encounter paths (high/moderate/low risk) or equivalent branching logic

assertions.name: high_risk_lower_albumin_than_moderate
assertions.description: High-risk branch albumin range.high < moderate-risk branch albumin range.low

assertions.name: high_risk_higher_bun_than_moderate
assertions.description: High-risk branch BUN range.low > moderate-risk branch BUN range.high

assertions.name: uses_active_condition_branching
assertions.description: Module uses Active Condition condition_type to detect sepsis and heart failure

assertions.name: all_loinc_codes_present
assertions.description: LOINC codes 1751-7 and 3094-0 appear in every branch

assertions.name: codes_validated_before_writing
assertions.description: Agent ran tx.fhir.org validation curl commands for all SNOMED and LOINC codes used
